programmes.d: The adventures of Ikki and his Medabot Metabee and their hopes to become champions of the Robattle competitions.
Ikki finds a medal that was accidentally dropped in the river by the Phantom Retort; Arika is in danger from the Screws.
Metabee disobeys; Henry explains the composition of Medabots.
Mr. Mountain is battling with crooks to save a park for young children.
Erika interviews an undefeated Medafighter for the school paper.
Ikki and Medabot train with the old master of the sea.
Rowen and Ryo encounter Lady Kayura and learn Talpa's forces have captured their friends, and must fight her to avoid the same fate.
The Ancient One's reappearance troubles Lady Kayura; as Ryo and Rowen seek a way into the Nether Realm to rescue their friends, they encounter a familiar face who pledges to help them.

Anubis attempts to gain Mia and Ully's trust and explains his past; Ryo and Rowen enter the Nether World in search of the other heroes; Talpa uses the energy of the captive heroes to create a new weapon.
Dala attacks Ryo and Rowen with Talpa's new sword, which allows him to use Cye, Kento and Sage's powers against them; the villains learn the full history behind Ryo's unbeatable Inferno Armor.

Badamon comes up with a plan to take control of Ryo's armor, but it requires Talpa to force his warlords to give up theirs; Lady Kayura enacts the plan, revealing another aspect of the Inferno Armor none of them knew.
Ryo rests from his taxing battle with Lady Kayura; Anubis and Mia come across something important in Mia's grandfather's research that could aid the heroes, drawing Talpa's attention to them.

Dyce leaves Conan trapped in an Industria holding cell and escapes with Lana to the Barracuda; he finds cover in a dense fog but Lepka is close behind.
With Lepka's gunboat in pursuit, Lana uses a lifeboat to rescue Conan from the open sea.
As they navigate a vast desert, Conan and Lana are discovered by a salvage ship captain named Patch.
Earthquakes rattle Industria as Lepka continues his search for Lana's grandfather Dr. Lao.
Conan, Lana, and Dr. Lao take to the skies in Dr. Lao's flying machine.
Trapped by Lepka, Lana and Dr. Lao must navigate Industria's Core Block in search of machine parts.

While in the old schoolhouse, Satsuki hears a haunting melody drifting through the halls; the only trouble is the lack of a pianist; if Satsuki hears the melody a total of four times, she'll die; the gang saddles up to put the ghostly piano to sleep.
The gang helps Keiichiro train for a sports festival at school; a mysterious boy shows up at the track meet, running alongside Keiichiro.

Stories spread about something preying on children who are all alone, and the gang gets scared; especially since their parents will be out for the night; a deadly ghost with a sickle in hand stalks Satsuki and her friends.

People all over town begin acting strangely; most of them have been replaced by mirror-world clones of themselves. With Satsuki and Hajime being the last two people in the town who haven't been swapped, they'll have to find a way to end this ghost.
Joe enters a crashed spaceship to elude the police of Mars, and gets entangled in an alien battle.
Joe gets acquainted with the Radorio mother ship while Hazzard is up to something opportunistic.
Joe tries to save Princess Romina from Hazzard, who wants to hand her over to Zaboom.
Princess Romina opens up about the big mission that brought her to the human beings.
Cherry takes Sakura's wand to be purified; without it, the ghosts and goblins haunt her in the school infirmary, causing her distress.
Onsen Mark orders the class to clean the school's swimming pool; Ten accidentally drops his alien snacks in the water, causing a problem for its mutated residents.
Kurama gets into an argument with Ran over a certain guy, and it gets worse when Ataru decides to get involved.
After receiving a letter from an admirer, Shinobu fondly looks back on the time she's spent with the note's furry author, whom she saved from a pack of dogs.
Ippo prepares for his future opponents.
Training camp on the beach.
The start of the Ippo vs. Kobashi match.
Kobashi has abandoned his strategy.
Astro heads to Mexico to help at an excavation near a Mayan pyramid and discovers Dr. Perez in a cryogenic chamber.
Astro meets three discarded robots and tries to find jobs for them; however, no one shows interest since they are non-registered.
Astro and Uran visit Bee Island, a breeding ground for bees, where they meet Christopher who is looking for his missing father.
A school field trip to a seismology department is interrupted by a robot constantly lying about an impending earthquake.
Scientists use robotic creations for competition; two robots from competing camps fall in love.
Led by a clue given by a robot Dr. Elephant assembled, Astro Boy heads to Antarctica with Daddy Walrus to investigate the gang of Black Looks and beat them off.
Medabee trains Cyandog to battle kindergarteners.
